entities.summary: Andrew David Joudrey is a former Canadian professional ice hockey forward who most recently played for the Adler Mannheim in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Joudrey was selected by the Washington Capitals in the 8th round of the 2003 NHL Entry Draft.
